findings.title: Rejected daemon release requests were treated as success
findings.suggested_fix: Check Response.ok and report non-success status through the existing onError callback.
findings.first_evidence: The release promise previously resolved for HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses.
findings.why_it_matters: A clean quit could appear to release daemon ownership even when the server rejected the request.
evidence: The lease release and shutdown paths now share halt(), which checks Response.ok.
A 503 response is covered by server-daemon-lease.test.ts.
